items.title: Bob Rosengarden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 6, 1996
items.q: I still get some re-runs on Sing Alongs, you know, with Mitch? The Thanksgiving Shows, Christmas Shows, they still somewhere in the world they play them.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. And all the new toys came in and it’s funny that you mention the Cavett Show, I got a call several months ago from somebody in California, I didn’t know who it was, and they said “I’m calling from Local 47, you know, A F of M, the musicians, and somebody is going to, just bought 26 Cavett shows, they’re going to cut them up. They have the right to do that. And there will be some re-run money on that.” And I learned many years ago, I still get some re-runs on Sing Alongs, you know, with Mitch? The…
It’s nice to see that kind of thing, that somewhere in the world they’re playing this and eventually you get your piece of it.
